items.title: Pay invoice for autumn garden work and hedge trimming
items.quote:
Wir bitten um Zahlung innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung, Abzüge
oder Skonto sind nicht vereinbart.
items.computation: The payment period is 14 days after receipt of the invoice ('nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung'), not 14 days after the invoice date. The invoice itself carries no printed date, and the letter does not state when it was sent or received by Mr. Musterbrügge, so the start of the 14-day period (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, day of receipt not counted) cannot be established. No reliable due date can therefore be computed.

warnings: The invoice has no printed invoice date and does not otherwise state the date it was sent or received, so the 14-day payment deadline ('innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung') cannot be computed; ask the recipient when the invoice actually arrived to fix the due date.
